name: SME Application Scorecard
description: Origination scorecard used to assess creditworthiness of new SME financing applications. Produces an application score mapped to an 8-grade masterscale used in credit decisioning and delegated approval authority.

lod_mapping.first_line: Credit Risk / SME Lending (development, use, monitoring)

tier_rationale: Drives origination decisions for the bank's core SME portfolio (>60% of financing assets); feeds IFRS 9 PD segmentation.

change_log.description: Redevelopment on 2019-2023 default data; added qualitative module for startups.
change_log.author: Rajesh Nair

change_log.description: Recalibration of score-to-PD mapping following masterscale review.
change_log.author: Rajesh Nair

audit_reviews.scope: Model use controls and override governance in SME origination.

implementation_platform: SAS scorecard engine, integrated with loan origination system
key_assumptions: Default definition of 90+ DPD / unlikeliness-to-pay, aligned to QCB guidance
2019-2023 development window remains representative of the current applicant mix
Qualitative startup module adequately compensates for thin-file applicants
known_limitations: Limited startup default history — startup module relies on expert weights
Credit bureau coverage gaps for newly established SMEs

name: SME Behavioural Scorecard
description: Behavioural scorecard for existing SME obligors using account conduct, utilisation and repayment behaviour. Used for limit management, renewals and early collections routing.
tier_rationale: Determines limit and renewal decisions across the performing SME book; feeds behavioural PD used in IFRS 9 staging.

change_log.description: Redevelopment with 24-month behavioural window; new utilisation volatility factor.
change_log.author: Lina Haddad

key_assumptions: 24-month behavioural observation window captures repayment dynamics
Utilisation volatility factor remains predictive across the cycle
known_limitations: Gini declined below the 0.50 threshold — recalibration outstanding
Bureau data quality assessment never completed (open condition)

name: Corporate Internal Rating Model
description: Internal risk rating model for corporate and project finance exposures combining financial ratio analysis with structured qualitative assessment. Output is a 10-grade obligor rating.

lod_mapping.second_line: Model Validation Unit (oversight of external validation)

tier_rationale: Rates large single-name exposures including project finance; low default portfolio raises model risk due to data scarcity.

change_log.description: Qualitative overlay weights recalibrated per external validation conditions.
change_log.author: Omar Farouk

audit_reviews.scope: Rating override rates and justification documentation for corporate exposures.

implementation_platform: Vendor rating workflow with in-house calibration templates
key_assumptions: Low-default portfolio benchmark mapping to external rating scales is appropriate
Qualitative module weights reflect true drivers of corporate default in Qatar
known_limitations: Override rate of 31% undermines model reliance (open high finding)
Data scarcity — very few internal defaults for statistical backtesting

name: Al Dhameen Guarantee Pricing & Risk Model
description: Prices partial credit guarantees issued to partner banks under the Al Dhameen program and estimates expected claims for provisioning and program capacity planning.
owner: Yousef Al-Emadi (Head of Al Dhameen Program)
tier_rationale: Guarantee program is a flagship government mandate; mispricing directly affects claims reserves and program sustainability.

change_log.description: New claims-based LGD calibration using partner bank recovery data.
change_log.author: Rajesh Nair

change_log.description: Interim fix to claim frequency assumption pending full remediation.
change_log.author: Rajesh Nair

implementation_platform: Excel with controls (versioned workbook, restricted access)
key_assumptions: Claim frequency derived from 2019-2021 partner-bank data remains applicable
LGD calibrated to observed program claims settlement experience
known_limitations: Realised claims running 40% above model expectation in manufacturing segment
No documented ongoing monitoring plan (finding open)

name: Early Warning System (EWS)
description: Machine learning model generating monthly early-warning signals for SME and corporate obligors using transactional behaviour, external bureau data and macro indicators. Triggers watchlist review workflow.
tier_rationale: Advisory tool (does not auto-decision) but high complexity ML methodology warrants Tier 2 with explainability requirements.

change_log.description: Added SHAP-based signal explanation for relationship managers.
change_log.author: David Chen

implementation_platform: Python / Databricks (ML pipeline with monthly scoring)
key_assumptions: Feature distributions managed via quarterly drift monitoring and refresh
Historic early-warning signals remain predictive of 12-month deterioration
known_limitations: Gradient boosting output requires SHAP-based explanation for credit officers
Elevated false-positive rate in the trading sector segment

name: Collateral Haircut Model
description: Sets haircuts applied to real estate, equipment and financial collateral for LTV computation and recovery estimation. Reviewed annually against realised liquidation outcomes.
tier_rationale: Simple deterministic haircut table; moderate materiality through LGD but low complexity and full transparency.

change_log.description: Formalised haircut table previously maintained in policy annex.
change_log.author: Credit Administration

key_assumptions: Historical liquidation discounts are representative of forced-sale conditions
Qatar real estate market liquidity assumptions hold for the main collateral classes
known_limitations: Sparse internal liquidation history — heavy reliance on expert judgement
Haircuts not yet differentiated by region within Qatar

name: IFRS 9 PD Term Structure Model
methodology: Markov Chain transition matrices with macro conditioning
description: Produces 12-month and lifetime point-in-time PD term structures by segment, conditioned on forward-looking macroeconomic scenarios. Core input to the ECL engine.
approval_body: Model Risk Committee + Board Audit Committee (noting)

lod_mapping.second_line: Model Validation Unit (oversight of external validation)

tier_rationale: Directly drives reported ECL provisions in audited financial statements; subject to external audit and QCB review.

change_log.description: Migration to Markov transition framework; segment granularity increased from 4 to 7 segments.
change_log.author: Lina Haddad

audit_reviews.scope: ECL production process controls and model input reconciliation.

key_assumptions: Markov property holds for rating transitions over the projection horizon
Macro conditioning via satellite regressions captures Qatar credit cycle
known_limitations: Short internal macro-default history limits satellite model robustness
Transition matrices sensitive to small counts in low-default grades

name: IFRS 9 LGD Model
methodology: Workout LGD with collateral-driven recovery cashflows
description: Estimates loss given default by segment and collateral type using discounted workout recoveries, including cure rates and time-to-recovery assumptions.
tier_rationale: Second-largest driver of ECL after PD; sensitive to sparse recovery data given the bank's development mandate.

change_log.description: Updated cure rate segmentation; discount rate aligned to EIR per audit recommendation.
change_log.author: Omar Farouk

key_assumptions: Workout recovery discount rate approximated by effective interest rate
48-month workout horizon captures substantially all recoveries
known_limitations: Equipment-collateral segment under-predicts losses (backtest ratio 1.24)
Sparse recovery observations for unsecured exposures

name: IFRS 9 EAD / CCF Model
description: Estimates exposure at default for revolving facilities, guarantees and undrawn commitments via credit conversion factors segmented by product.
tier_rationale: Supporting CCF input to the ECL suite with regulatory visibility, but methodologically simple and fully transparent.

change_log.description: Added guarantee-specific CCF segment for Al Dhameen exposures.
change_log.author: Lina Haddad

data_sources: Core banking limits and utilisation data
key_assumptions: Historical utilisation of defaulted revolvers predicts future EAD behaviour
CCFs stable across product types within each segment
known_limitations: Limited number of defaulted revolving facilities in the estimation sample
No differentiation of CCFs by time-to-default

name: SICR Staging Model
description: Determines significant increase in credit risk (Stage 1/2/3 allocation) using relative PD deterioration thresholds, days-past-due backstops, watchlist status and forbearance flags.
tier_rationale: Stage allocation is the largest single driver of ECL volatility and a recurring external audit focus area.

change_log.description: Moved from absolute to relative PD deterioration thresholds; added forbearance backstop.
change_log.author: Omar Farouk

key_assumptions: Relative PD-deterioration thresholds identify significant increase in credit risk
30-DPD backstop and qualitative flags capture cases the quantitative test misses
known_limitations: Threshold cliff effects can cause stage volatility at reporting dates
Qualitative backstops depend on timely watchlist maintenance

name: Macroeconomic Scenario & Overlay Model
methodology: Satellite regression models + expert scenario weights
description: Generates baseline, upside and downside macroeconomic scenarios (Qatar GDP, oil price, real estate index, interest rates) with probability weights, and computes management overlays applied to modelled ECL.

lod_mapping.second_line: Model Validation Unit (validation not yet performed)

tier_rationale: Scenario weights and overlays materially move reported ECL; expert judgement components increase model risk.

change_log.description: Initial build to replace auditor-provided scenarios.
change_log.author: David Chen

change_log.description: Oil price satellite model re-estimated.
change_log.author: David Chen

implementation_platform: Excel with controls + R satellite regressions
key_assumptions: Three-scenario (base/up/down) design with expert-set weights spans the outcome space
Satellite regressions on short Qatari macro series are directionally reliable
known_limitations: Never independently validated — in production without approval (open high finding)
Scenario weights are expert judgement without formal backtesting

name: IRRBB Model (EVE & NII)
methodology: Repricing gap analysis with behavioural assumptions
description: Measures interest rate risk in the banking book via Economic Value of Equity and Net Interest Income sensitivity under QCB and Basel standard rate shocks, including behavioural assumptions for non-maturity deposits and prepayments.
owner: Mohammed Al-Marri (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)
tier_rationale: Feeds ALCO limits with QCB regulatory visibility; moderate balance sheet complexity limits materiality.

change_log.description: Non-maturity deposit behavioural life recalibrated to 3.2 years.
change_log.author: Treasury Middle Office

implementation_platform: ALM vendor system with in-house behavioural assumptions
key_assumptions: Non-maturity deposit behavioural life of 2.5 years core / 0.5 years volatile
Prepayment rates on fixed-rate financing stable at observed averages
known_limitations: Behavioural assumptions rest on limited rate-cycle history in Qatar
Basis risk between benchmark curves simplified

name: FX Exposure Model
description: Measures foreign exchange risk on the bank's limited open currency positions using parametric VaR with 99% confidence over a 10-day horizon.
owner: Mohammed Al-Marri (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)
tier_rationale: Minimal open FX positions (QAR/USD peg); simple methodology, limit monitoring use only.

change_log.description: Correlation matrix update cycle moved to quarterly.
change_log.author: Treasury Middle Office

key_assumptions: Returns approximately normal over 1-day horizon; 250-day covariance window
QAR/USD peg stability maintained
known_limitations: Parametric VaR understates tail risk in stressed conditions
Minor currency exposures proxied via USD correlations

name: Liquidity Stress Testing & LCR/NSFR Model
methodology: Cashflow projection with stress runoff assumptions
description: Projects contractual and behavioural cashflows under idiosyncratic, market-wide and combined stress scenarios; computes LCR/NSFR and survival horizon for ALCO and QCB reporting.
owner: Mohammed Al-Marri (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)

lod_mapping.second_line: Market & Liquidity Risk / Model Validation Unit

tier_rationale: Regulatory liquidity ratios and board survival-horizon appetite depend on this model; runoff assumptions are judgement-heavy.

change_log.description: Added combined stress scenario and intraday liquidity module.
change_log.author: Treasury Middle Office

audit_reviews.scope: Liquidity reporting controls and assumption governance.

implementation_platform: Excel with controls + treasury system extracts
key_assumptions: Stress runoff rates by depositor type calibrated to QCB and Basel guidance
Government-related deposits behave as stable funding under stress
known_limitations: Government-related deposit runoff assumptions based on pre-2024 data (open finding)
Manual spreadsheet process creates operational risk in monthly production

name: Investment Portfolio Valuation Model
description: Vendor pricing service used for independent valuation of the bank's fixed income investment portfolio, including sukuk with limited market liquidity. Subject to vendor model risk management standards.
owner: Mohammed Al-Marri (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)
tier_rationale: Vendor black-box pricing for less-liquid sukuk requires compensating controls (IPV); moderate portfolio size.

change_log.description: Vendor service onboarded with IPV control framework.
change_log.author: Treasury Middle Office

key_assumptions: Vendor pricing hierarchy (traded > quoted > modelled) yields fair value
BVAL scores above threshold indicate reliable pricing quality
known_limitations: IPV variance above 50bps on a small number of illiquid sukuk positions
Vendor methodology transparency limited (black-box elements)

name: AML Transaction Monitoring System
description: Vendor transaction monitoring system generating alerts for suspicious activity across all customer transactions. Scenario thresholds are bank-configured and require periodic tuning and above/below-the-line testing.
tier_rationale: AML failures carry severe regulatory and reputational consequences under Qatar AML/CFT Law No. 20 of 2019; vendor black-box components require rigorous tuning governance.

change_log.description: Scenario threshold retuning for cash-intensive SME segments (partial - remediation ongoing).
change_log.author: Compliance Technology

audit_reviews.scope: Alert backlog management and scenario tuning evidence.

implementation_platform: Vendor system (SAS AML), configured by Compliance Technology
usage_frequency: Daily batch scenario runs + real-time scoring
key_assumptions: Customer risk segmentation reflects actual ML/TF risk profiles
Vendor scenario library covers Qatar-relevant typologies
known_limitations: Majority of scenarios still at vendor default thresholds — 91% false positive rate
Anomaly scoring component has limited explainability

name: Sanctions Screening System
description: Screens customers and payments against sanctions lists (UN, local designations) and PEP databases using configurable fuzzy-matching thresholds.
tier_rationale: Sanctions breaches carry strict-liability regulatory exposure; matching threshold configuration is a key model risk.

change_log.description: Fuzzy matching threshold recalibrated after effectiveness testing.
change_log.author: Compliance Technology

key_assumptions: Fuzzy-matching thresholds balance detection versus false positives appropriately
Watchlist updates applied within 24 hours of publication
known_limitations: Arabic name transliteration variants challenge match accuracy
Threshold calibration relies on vendor benchmarking, not local testing

name: Fraud Detection Model
description: Real-time fraud scoring for digital banking transactions, flagging anomalous payment patterns for step-up authentication or manual review. Currently in independent validation prior to go-live.
tier_rationale: Customer-impacting real-time decisions with ML complexity; fraud losses currently modest (low materiality).
regulatory_mapping: QCB operational risk / consumer protection instructions

change_log.description: Candidate model submitted for independent validation.
change_log.author: David Chen

key_assumptions: Confirmed fraud labels are substantially complete after 90-day maturation
Class rebalancing (SMOTE) does not distort score calibration
known_limitations: Severe class imbalance — fraud rate below 0.1% of transactions
Model still in validation; not yet approved for autonomous blocking

name: Operational Risk Scenario & RCSA Model
description: Structured scoring model aggregating risk and control self-assessments and scenario workshops into an operational risk profile and capital add-on estimate.
tier_rationale: Qualitative aggregation tool; informs but does not determine capital or provisions.

change_log.description: Formalised scoring methodology previously embedded in RCSA templates.
change_log.author: Operational Risk Team

key_assumptions: Expert frequency/severity scores approximate the true operational loss profile
Scenario set covers the bank's material operational risk exposures
known_limitations: Inherent subjectivity of expert scoring; anchoring bias risk
Sparse internal loss history for tail scenarios

name: Capital Planning & Stress Testing Model
methodology: Balance sheet projection with satellite risk models
description: Projects the bank's balance sheet, P&L and capital adequacy over a 3-year horizon under baseline and stress scenarios, integrating credit, market, liquidity and operational risk model outputs for ICAAP submission.
tier_rationale: Determines ICAAP capital adequacy conclusions presented to the board and QCB; aggregates multiple upstream model risks.

change_log.description: Stress scenario library extended with regional geopolitical scenario.
change_log.author: Finance / Risk joint team

implementation_platform: Excel with controls + satellite model feeds
key_assumptions: Balance sheet growth plans achievable under base scenario
Satellite model stress elasticities transferable to QDB portfolio
known_limitations: Manual spreadsheet transfers from satellite models (open finding, BCBS 239)
Limited Qatar-specific stress episodes for scenario severity benchmarking

name: Climate Risk Scoring Model
description: Sector- and counterparty-level climate risk scoring covering transition risk (carbon intensity, policy exposure) and physical risk (heat, water stress, coastal exposure in Qatar). Intended to feed credit appetite and future TCFD-style disclosures.
tier_rationale: Emerging regulatory expectations on climate risk; scores may influence credit appetite once operational.

change_log.description: Pilot sector heatmap completed for manufacturing and construction portfolios.
change_log.author: ESG working group

data_sources: Qatar National Climate Change Plan references
key_assumptions: Sector-level physical and transition risk factor weights reflect Qatar exposure
Counterparty data gaps can be proxied by sector averages in the pilot phase
known_limitations: Model in development — methodology and data coverage still evolving
Client-level emissions data largely unavailable

name: Loan Pricing & Profitability Model
description: Computes risk-based pricing floors and facility-level RAROC using funds transfer pricing, expected loss and capital allocation, balancing the bank's development mandate with financial sustainability.
tier_rationale: Influences pricing decisions bank-wide but subsidised-mandate pricing reduces pure model reliance.

change_log.description: FTP curve methodology updated to reflect new funding structure.
change_log.author: Finance Analytics

implementation_platform: Excel with controls + finance data marts
usage_frequency: At deal pricing; monthly profitability reporting
key_assumptions: Capital allocation per exposure follows the regulatory ratio plus buffer
FTP curve reflects QDB's actual marginal funding cost
known_limitations: Risk parameters refresh with a one-quarter lag versus pricing decisions
Development-bank subsidy mandate complicates pure RAROC interpretation
